name: Critical Effects (DH2): Rending - Leg
description: Dark Heresy 2nd Edition, Table 7-22 (p. 241). Look up the total Critical Damage. Mechanical effects only - read the full description from the rulebook.

results.text: Challenging (+0) Agility test or fall Prone and suffer Blood Loss.
Knocked Prone and [[1d10]] Agility damage. Movement halved (rounding up) until medical attention.
Blood Loss. Challenging (+0) Toughness test; on a failure, Agility permanently reduced by 1.
Blood Loss. Challenging (+0) Toughness test: on a success Movement is halved (rounding up) until medical attention, on a failure he gains the Lost Foot condition.
Stunned for 1 round, knocked Prone and Blood Loss. The leg is Useless until medical attention.
Immediate Challenging (+0) Toughness test or die from shock. On a success: Stunned for [[1d10]] rounds and Blood Loss. Gains the Lost Leg condition.
As result 9. For the rest of the encounter, anyone making a Run or Charge action within 6 metres of the corpse must pass a Challenging (+0) Agility test or be knocked Prone.
